output.explanation: NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018834 booked AED 347,472.00 against NIG-AE invoice AE-ICINV-00924 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031219, AED 365,760.00) on the same date with the same project. The 0.95 ratio matches Saudi 5% WHT on services, and the buyer description explicitly says 'net of WHT 5%'. output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to AED 365,760 and record the AED 18,288 withheld as a WHT liability to ZATCA; NIG-AE should then clear the same amount from its IC receivable to WHT expense or a tax receivable once it gets the WHT certificate.
